summary.text: Michael Nigro is a Democratic state representative from Vermont who has represented the Bennington-5 District since January 2025 and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Vermont House from 2021 to 2023 and is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Michael Nigro earned a B.A. in political science and an M.B.A. from Plymouth State University in 2009.
His career experience includes working as the director of BAYADA Home Health Care and co-owning Green Mountain Concessions.
Nigro served in the Vermont House of Representatives for the former Bennington 2-2 District from 2021 to 2023, when he was assigned to the Commerce and Economic Development Committee.
He returned to the House in January 2025 and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
